items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels will not be placed on IR; after imaging and specialist consults on dislocated left elbow, he is week-to-week. Ruled out this weekend vs Seahawks but aiming to return ASAP.
items.why: Imaging evaluated, multiple specialists consulted; consensus week-to-week.
items.implication: Marcus Mariota likely starts; short-term hit to WAS pass catchers but not season-long tank.
items.opportunity: Monitor McLaurin/others with Mariota; Daniels return ASAP possible next weeks.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua DNP for second straight day with hip injury; McVay says not long-term but cautious, may miss Sunday vs DEN.
items.why: Hip injury, not making great progress per McVay; erring on caution, no hernia.
items.implication: Likely another miss elevates Adams heavily.
items.opportunity: Adams routes/targets spike; Ferguson TE involvement.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins DNP second straight day with hamstring; looking long shot for Sunday vs IND.
items.implication: Target share redistributes to Schultz and others.
items.opportunity: Schultz 30% routes/28% share previously sans Collins; good TE matchup vs IND.

items.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart knee surgery today (meniscus and MCL repair); out for regular season per coach (was John Harbaugh? wait Giants). Injured MNF vs Rams.
items.why: MCL/meniscus repair; belief out regular season.
items.implication: NYG QB carousel; impacts Nabers/Skattebo etc. long-term.
items.opportunity: Backup QB and skill players volatility.

items.text: Davante Adams has run 142 routes without Puka Nacua as a Ram, targeted on 60 (42%). Results in two games Puka missed: 5-35-3 vs JAX 2025; 8-195-2 vs NYG Monday.
items.why: High target rate and production when Nacua out; McVay cautious on Nacua.
items.implication: Adams WR1 upside if Nacua misses again vs DEN.
items.opportunity: 42% target share on routes; elite volume/efficiency.

items.text: With Nico Collins out last week, Dalton Schultz targeted on 30% of routes, team-high 28% target share. Faces Colts allowing 4th-most yards to TEs. Love for Week3.
items.why: Elevated target share sans Collins + strong TE matchup.
items.implication: TE streamer/start with Collins likely out.
items.opportunity: 30% route targets, 28% share; IND soft vs TE.

items.text: After Rhamondre Stevenson 1Q fumble, TreVeyon Henderson led NE backfield 65% snaps, out-touched 16-5 rest of game. Gap narrowed but Stevenson still ranked ahead Week3.
items.why: Post-fumble snap/touch dominance; pass pro still question for full takeover.
items.implication: Henderson rising but committee; monitor for lead role.
items.conflict: Berry still ranks Stevenson higher short-term.

items.text: Drake London 12 career games with Michael Penix: avg over 20 PPR, 35% target share, 97 rec yds/game. Penix return boosts.
items.why: Elite historical production/target share with Penix.
items.implication: London WR1 boost with healthy Penix (TNF notes).
items.opportunity: 35% share, 97 yds avg; Pitts also benefits per Levitan TNF.

items.text: Zay Flowers first hurt hamstring Aug 20 joint practice. Seemed fine, 5-150-1 first half Week1 but aggravated, hasn't practiced full since. Ravens to Brazil this week.
items.implication: High risk OUT; fade if active or monitor backups.

items.text: Derrick Henry love vs DAL in Brazil: highest RB rush yards prop (88.5); Dallas 30th in rush D allowing 173.5 ypg ground.
items.why: Elite matchup vs soft run D + high prop.
items.opportunity: Volume + efficiency vs poor DAL run defense.

items.text: Chase Brown love @ PIT: at least 20 touches + 15% target share both games; RB7 utilization (86). PIT allows 5th-most rush ypg to RBs.
items.opportunity: 20+ touches, receiving work vs soft PIT run D.

items.text: Chris Olave love vs LV: double-digit targets both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards. LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs.
items.why: High volume/aDOT + soft secondary allowing big plays.
items.opportunity: Dominant air yards share vs leaky LV pass D.

items.text: Terry McLaurin hate vs SEA: SEA fewest FP to WRs, opp WRs 7.9 ypr league-low. WAS lowest implied total (17). Also 25% tgt share historically with Mariota but tough spot.
items.why: Elite SEA pass D + low team total + Daniels out.
items.implication: Sit despite Mariota history; tough environment.
items.conflict: Historical Mariota chemistry positive but matchup overrides.
